tutorial.title: Welcome to Sudoku!
tutorial.body: The goal is to fill each 'Unit' with 1–9 — no repeats. Auto Sudoku makes it easy!

tutorial.title: What is a Unit?
tutorial.body: A unit is a row, column, or 3×3 box. Each must contain 1–9 exactly once—no repeats.

tutorial.title: Rows
tutorial.body: Each row is a unit. Digits 1–9 can appear only once across the row.

tutorial.title: Columns
tutorial.body: Each column is also a unit. Digits 1–9 can appear only once vertically.

tutorial.title: 3×3 Boxes
tutorial.body: 3×3 boxes are also units. Make sure digits 1–9 appear exactly once inside.

tutorial.title: Filled Cells
tutorial.body: Tap a filled cell and we softly gray out where that number can’t go — perfect for focusing your search. Give it a try!

tutorial.title: Empty Cells
tutorial.body: Tap an empty cell and we softly gray out where that number can't "see". The peers in the selected cell's row, column and box will stay lit.

tutorial.title: Tap a 2
tutorial.body: Tap any filled 2 — we’ll use it to spot something sneaky.

tutorial.title: Hidden Single
tutorial.body: Spot the standout? Only one cell stays lit in the top-left box — a hidden single. Give it a tap!

tutorial.title: First Hidden Single Done!
tutorial.body: Nice job! We've filled in the 2 in this box. A hidden single says 'There is only one spot available for a digit in this unit, so it must go here!' Let's keep looking for more!

tutorial.title: Next Hidden Single
tutorial.body: Spot another lonely home for a 2 in this row? Give it a tap!

tutorial.title: Last Hidden Single
tutorial.body: This column has one cozy spot left for a 2 — finish the set by tapping it!

tutorial.title: Complete the Puzzle
tutorial.body: Hidden Singles are just the beginning! Tap on more filled cells to find Hidden Singles and finish this puzzle. Happy tapping!
